title: Make a complaint about the content of a number plate
summary: You can make a complaint about a NSW number plate if you find the content offensive or inappropriate.
intro:
If you see a NSW number plate which you find offensive or inappropriate, you can make a complaint online, by email or phone.

A committee of diverse people will review your complaint. The number plates will be recalled if they are deemed to give rise to controversy or public disagreement.
what_you_need: the reason(s) you find the number plate content offensive or inappropriate
your personal details and email address (not needed if making an anonymous complaint by phone).

how_to_steps.text: Choose your preferred option (online form, email or phone) to make your complaint.
If you submit your complaint online or by email, you'll receive a confirmation email.
Complaints will usually be reviewed within 30 days. Urgent complaints will be assessed sooner.
For privacy reasons, you will not be notified of the outcome of your complaint.
